why_use_section.title: Why Devisgon Builds Automation with Google Apps Script
why_use_section.subtitle: Google Apps Script gives businesses a flexible automation layer for connecting Google Workspace tools, managing data, reducing manual tasks, and building custom workflows without heavy infrastructure.
paragraphs: We use Google Apps Script for businesses that rely on Google Workspace and need custom automation beyond basic app features. It is suitable for Google Sheets reporting, Gmail automation, Drive file management, Forms processing, Calendar scheduling, Docs generation, approval workflows, notifications, and API based integrations.

For startups, agencies, education platforms, healthcare teams, real estate businesses, service companies, eCommerce teams, finance departments, and global operations teams, Apps Script can turn everyday Google Workspace activity into structured automation. Devisgon builds these systems with clean logic, secure data handling, reliable triggers, scalable architecture, and long term maintainability.
